page_notes.218: 6 Hole - 30 Degree Angled Flat Plate (4-54): 4330 and 4330-Black (15) extracted; metric 40-4330/-Black skipped. Suggested hardware 3320 x6 attached; metric 75-3422 skipped.
page_notes.219: 4 Hole - 45 Degree Angled Flat Plate (4-55): 4346 and 4346-Black (15) extracted; 10 series 4145/-Black and metric 40-4346/-Black skipped. Suggested hardware 3320 x4 attached; 3321 (10) and 75-3422 (metric) skipped.
page_notes.220: 6 Hole - 45 Degree Angled Flat Plate (4-56): 4345 and 4345-Black (15) extracted; metric 40-4345/-Black skipped. Suggested hardware 3320 x6 attached; metric 75-3422 skipped.
page_notes.221: 4 Hole - 60 Degree Angled Flat Plate (4-57): 4361 and 4361-Black (15) extracted; 10 series 4164/-Black and metric 40-4361/-Black skipped. Suggested hardware 3320 x4 attached; 3321 (10) and 75-3422 (metric) skipped.
page_notes.222: 6 Hole - 60 Degree Angled Flat Plate (4-58): 4362 and 4362-Black (15) extracted; metric 40-4362/-Black skipped. Suggested hardware 3320 x6 attached; metric 75-3422 skipped.
page_notes.223: 4 Hole - Tee Flat Plate (4-59): 4341 and 4341-Black (15 + RT) extracted; 10 series 4141/-Black and metric 25-4141, 40-4341 (and -Black) skipped. T-slot hardware 3320 x4 attached; Ready Tube hardware 3960 x4 (RT only) recorded in notes.
page_notes.224: 5 Hole - Tee Flat Plate (4-60): 4340 and 4340-Black (15 + RT) extracted; 10 series 4140/-Black and metric 25-4140, 30-4340, 40-4340, 45-4340 (and -Black) skipped. T-slot hardware 3320 x5 attached; Ready Tube hardware 3960 x5 (RT only) recorded in notes.
page_notes.225: 6 Hole - Tee Flat Plate (4-61): 4310 and 4310-Black (15 + RT) extracted; 10 series 4123/-Black skipped. T-slot hardware 3320 x6 attached; Ready Tube hardware 3960 x6 (RT only) recorded in notes.

remaining_doubts: 4341/4341-Black, 4340/4340-Black, 4310/4310-Black are badged 15 + RT; the 'Mount to Ready Tube' row 3960 is RT-only, so it is recorded in notes, not in suggested_hardware, per the 15/F-rows rule. Downstream may want it as structured hardware.

dimension_notes letters were read from the drawings; G (side edge below the angled cut / straight side edge) and J (vertical offset from the angled-leg hole to the hole row) are interpretations of the drawing, not printed definitions.
